verdict.rationale: AWS ships Bedrock AgentCore, a documented end-to-end managed platform for building, deploying, and running agents at scale — with runtime, identity/auth handling, observability/tracing ('see what steps your agent took'), and support for any framework (LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Strands SDK) and any model, plus Bedrock itself providing model access. This is first-party documented infrastructure, not just a vision post. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of AgentCore in production and more granular docs on orchestration internals beyond marketing pages.
